document.notes: The form's own face reads 'Do not attach to your tax return. Keep for your records.' It is nonetheless the sole input to Form 8962, which IS filed. PART III STATES THE SAME TWELVE MONTHS TWICE: as monthly rows (lines 21-32, January to December) and as an annual total row (line 33), in each of the three columns — A monthly enrollment premiums, B monthly second lowest cost silver plan (SLCSP) premium, C monthly advance payment of premium tax credit. Routing both the annual row and the monthly rows reports every premium and every advance payment twice, doubling BOTH sides of the reconciliation. Form 8962 line 10 decides which path a given taxpayer uses, and the two are mutually exclusive: every monthly route here carries `when uses_annual_ptc_calculation is false` and every annual route carries `when` it is true. This is deliberately NOT modelled as an aggregate — an aggregate names THE reportable box of a printed group and here neither row is, because the choice is conditional rather than structural; and it is deliberately not modelled with role:'informs' either, because each figure is ENTERED on a printed entry line of Form 8962 and line 24 SUMS the monthly ones, which only a placing route may do. The assembler for this part asserts the exclusivity over all 39 routes instead of trusting this note.
